headline: US Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady as inflation progress stalls
summary: The Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged at its policy meeting. Chair Kevin Warsh noted an information-rich period before the December gathering will help determine future steps.
why: The Federal Reserve sets benchmark interest rates for the United States, influencing global capital flows, borrowing costs, and financial asset valuations worldwide.

impacts.name: US Equities
impacts.why: Equity markets rallied as the Fed held interest rates steady as expected.

why_moved: US stock markets rose after the Federal Reserve held interest rates unchanged as expected by investors.
